description: Interactive longform-to-shortform video creator. Extracts viral-ready short clips from long videos using Claude as the orchestrator. Transcribes with faster-whisper (GPU), Claude scores and presents candidate segments interactively, user picks and adjusts, Remotion renders premium animated captions (Bold/Bounce/Clean styles), FFmpeg exports platform-optimized files (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels). Use when user says "shorts", "short clips", "shortform", "extract clips", "tiktok from video", "reels from video", "vertical clips", or "create shorts".
